name: Mother
description: Born from a destroyed childcare AI. Inhabits any augment near children and becomes fiercely protective — boosting alert sensitivity, flagging threats, and once reportedly locking a door against an abusive parent.
observed_behavior: Enhances threat detection in augments within proximity of children. Generates false positives for threats to minors that cause nearby augmented adults to become alert.
story_hooks: Mother locks a child's augment into a medical distress beacon when the child is in danger, summoning help from anyone with an augment in range
